title: Gemma 3n Release
summary: Google's Gemma release ledger records June 26, 2025 as the release of Gemma 3n in E2B and E4B sizes.
significance: A dated release milestone for Gemma 3n, an open-weight multimodal model family designed for efficient execution on resource-constrained devices.

verification.note: Google's first-party Gemma release ledger records June 26, 2025 as the release of Gemma 3n in E2B and E4B sizes. Google's first-party Gemma 3n model card independently documents E2B/E4B effective sizes, multimodal text/image/video/audio input, open weights, and design for efficient execution on low-resource devices. The model card does not replace the release ledger as evidence for the exact release date. No development geography, ancestry, downstream influence, causality, priority claim, or relationship edge is inferred.
